Derive an informative flexyBayes prior from a simulation ensemble

Source: R/fb_pesto.R
fb_prior_from_ensemble.Rd

Constructs an fb_prior from a calibrated parameter ensemble – the "generalise" step that carries a process-model calibration forward into a flexyBayes fit. The ensemble is ingested through the C5 contract (as_fb_ensemble()), so any conforming producer works (a PESTO manifest, a raw apsimx ensemble, a file).

Usage

fb_prior_from_ensemble(
  ensemble,
  method = c("moments", "pesto", "kde"),
  parameters = NULL
)

Arguments

ensemble

A C5 ensemble source: an fb_ensemble, a PESTO pesto_ensemble_manifest, a list(params, outputs, ...), or a file path.

method

One of "moments" (default), "pesto", "kde".

parameters

Optional character vector selecting a subset of the ensemble's parameter columns. NULL (default) uses all of them.

Value

An fb_prior object (see fb_prior()), ready to pass to flexybayes(..., prior = ).

Details

The "moments" method (the default, self-contained) fits an independent normal(mean, sd) prior to each parameter from its ensemble marginal mean and standard deviation, emitted as b("<param>") ~ normal(mean, sd) fixed-effect priors. Cross-parameter correlation is discarded – the moment-only path keeps the marginals, not the joint. The richer joint method ("pesto", the PESTO-native prior preserving covariance + positive-orthant structure) and the kernel-density method ("kde", via kernR) are specified but not yet wired; they raise a structured error naming their gate and the available fallback.

See also

fb_pesto(), as_fb_ensemble(), fb_prior().

Examples

e <- fb_ensemble(
  params = data.frame(k = stats::rnorm(50, 2, 0.3),
                      r = stats::rnorm(50, 0.5, 0.1)),
  outputs = data.frame(yield = stats::rnorm(50))
)
p <- fb_prior_from_ensemble(e)
p
#> <fb_prior> 2 specifications
#>   b("k") ~ normal(mean = 1.9888, sd = 0.3417627)
#>   b("r") ~ normal(mean = 0.5005054, sd = 0.1030884)
